release_notes:
1. Added dedicated PrestaShop Webhook Client template for Server GTM (prestashop-client-template.tpl) for 100% deterministic parameter mapping into Common Event Data.
2. Added configurable Webhook Endpoint Path (default: /ps-webhook, with direct /data Stape Data Client compatibility).
3. Enriched JSON webhook payloads with top-level event_name, financial totals, and user data for zero-latency real-time debugging.
